role: Observed uninterrupted pale plaster upper return walls facing the open Norssi entrance forecourt; no apartment windows

references.title: Google Street View actual Norssi forecourt, August2024, plain upper side returns on both sides of entrance actually opened

observations: The actual forecourt has large unfenestrated pale plaster return walls above the low front porch on both sides. They are genuine plain architectural faces, not missing apartment-window texture.
Only the exact elevated support planes beginning14.577m are selected. Lower side walls, small vents and ground features are not inferred through the porch.
The upper native roof/gable steps are retained exactly. A uniform original pale finish is intentional; no photograph or invented windows are applied.
limitations: Selected source planes only. Thin roof-edge brick trim is not reconstructed by this material-finish profile.
Other wings, lower returns, court facades and the separate northeast school remain pending; this is not complete whole-BID coverage.
Runtime and final post-road/tram binding remain required.
